planning.reference: historically fitted model1, not test topology or test voltage
planning.forecast: existing issued forecast.npy, used as the power mean without reconditioning it on test observations
planning.power_error: existing training RMS, offpeak4percent/peak8percent, timeAR0.8, channel correlation0.25; fixed additive Gaussian covariance
planning.voltage_error: existing likelihood_sd from the historical input; independent remaining Gaussian error conditional on power
planning.dr_in_planning: original deterministic nominal delivery; multiplicative correlated and saturated delivery is independently evaluated as model mismatch
planning.resources: all original 60 resources on all 15 nodes; no reallocation or enlargement
planning.cost: original nonnegative prepaid quadratic contract fee; no imposed total fee upper bound
planning.zero_rule: If zero delivery passes the sufficient condition, certify global minimum fee0; do not force paid DR

evaluation.rotation: prespecified resource-phase hourly alternation, scaled before evaluation to the optimized prepaid fee; feasible original device projection
evaluation.response: original Devices.draw(main) correlated whole-path Gaussian multipliers, followed by original device projection
evaluation.ac: original radial AC producer and original P/Q/root/terminal meter observer
evaluation.selection: original frozen-pair MAE common3percent plus original .16 output map; new day weight1 as previously requested, no refit
evaluation.failures: Retain each failure/timeout/unresolved; report planned denominator, never drop/renormalize
evaluation.identical_contracts: Reuse an identical physical observation for aliases within a path, explicitly report unique AC count
evaluation.truth_gate: Freeze all observed selections before computing true support errors
